newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila C.Bank says will keep 20 pct o/night rate.
newsitem.headline: Manila C.Bank says will keep 20 pct o/night rate.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Friday it will keep its overnight borrowing rate at 20 percent in order to punish speculators.
"The market is speculating we'll lower the overnight rate on Monday...But we'll keep it at that level until the market is no longer speculating," Central Bank Treasurer Sergio Edeza told Reuters.
He said the Central Bank was buying dollars in the afternoon after it lifted its overnight borrowing rate to 20 from 13 percent.
But overall on Friday, the Central Bank was a net seller of dollars, he said.
The peso has been under attack in recent days due to the backlash from the problems of the Thai baht.
In just two days, the Central Bank had to lift its overnight borrowing rate by a total of 8.75 percentage points.
On Friday, volume on the Philippine foreign exchange market reached its highest ever level. Late in the session, it was at $647 million.
